mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_portfolio_annual_settlement (portfolio_code, settle_year, boundary_time, rule_version, settlement_status, degrade_reason, last_attempt_at, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{settlement.portfolioCode}, #{settlement.settleYear}, #{settlement.boundaryTime}, #{settlement.ruleVersion}, #{settlement.settlementStatus}, #{settlement.degradeReason}, #{settlement.lastAttemptAt}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (portfolio_code, settle_year, rule_version) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING

mapper.update: UPDATE torn_stock_portfolio_annual_settlement SET settlement_status = #{settlement.settlementStatus}, degrade_reason = #{settlement.degradeReason}, last_attempt_at = #{businessNow}, update_time = #{businessNow} WHERE id = #{settlement.id} AND deleted = 0 AND settlement_status <> 'SETTLED'
